description: Golden cases for the pkg hash a marker carries: what a template renders for fixed kwargs, hashed so a harness can tell a region rendered from an older package without linking Sedum. Decided by prov-2026-66bea9f3.

cases.why: A simple action's one template is keyed by the empty string. Descriptions are left out: they reach the model, never the renderer, so editing one must not mark a region stale. A declared default is in, written as its value; an undeclared one is null.

files.rails/sedum.yaml:
name: rails
extensions: [".rb"]
comment_prefix: "#"
transforms:
  constantize: [singular, pascal]
  instantize: [plural, "prefix:@"]
op_exceptions:
  pascal:
    api: API

cases.why: Each variant's template is keyed by variant name, the _default fallback included. variants keep declaration order, because that is the order the author wrote and nothing sorts it.
